locator.text: Display 79.7, p. 79, in the proof of Proposition 7.2

evidence: paper: D_H H_w = I_2 - v_t\lambda_t, \qquad D_H^a H_w = 0 \quad (a \ge 2), \qquad D_H v = T_g^{\,i-i_0}\lambda_t / c_i = O(S_*).

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean never writes the three formulas in the paper's matrix notation, but every clause is covered by stated declarations and the rewriting is algebra. (1) path_eq_affine says H ↦ H_w at fixed w is affine with linear part pathLinear = pointLinear ∘ horizontal ∘ coordinateLinear. Since pointLinear and coordinateLinear are mutually inverse (coverPower⁻¹∘basis and basis⁻¹∘coverPower) and horizontal z = z − z.2•(0,1), pathLinear Y = Y − (coordinateLinear Y).2 • slotDirection g; equivalently this is read off path_eq_shift plus coordinates_eq_affine. For the band geometry with the native basis (basis(0,1) = c_i • timeDirection, native_band_path) and the stated eigenvector lemmas cover_pow_timeDirection / cover_pow_radialDirection, slotDirection = T_g^{-gap} c_i v_t and (coordinateLinear Y).2 = T_g^{gap} λ_t(Y)/c_i, so the product is v_t λ_t: the paper's I_2 − v_t λ_t. (2) D_H^a H_w = 0 for a ≥ 2 is the affineness in path_eq_affine; no separate declaration states it, and the Lean consumes it through norm_iteratedFDeriv_affine_le / norm_path_pullback_jet_le. (3) D_H v is the second component of coordinateLinear (coordinates_eq_affine); its size O(S_*) is bandGeometry_argumentCost_le (argumentCost ≥ ‖coordinateLinear‖ by definition, bounded by a constant fixed before band, centre and copy times ChartScales.S n = n², the paper's S_* = ℓ²), instantiated on the constructed slot geometry by slotGeometry_argumentCost. The Lean states slightly more than the display (arbitrary Geometry, and a bound on the whole of coordinateLinear and pointLinear, not only the pulse-coordinate component). I did not check that the paper's λ_t(w) = v_t·w/(1+b_g²) equals the second coordinate of nativeBasis.symm beyond noting radialDirection ⟂ timeDirection from their definitions, and I did not trace the instantiation chain from slotGeometry_argumentCost into the Proposition 7.2 solve.
